scope: Repo-level harness and /lib work. Per-video work lives in videos/<slug>/feature_list.json.
note: Status is the only field a steady-state session flips. Never reword or delete acceptance criteria to make an item pass — that is a correctness bug, not a shortcut.

features.title: Harness core: theme, utils, transitions, Evaluator, protected paths
acceptance: init.sh brings a cold machine to a working manim install, idempotently
scripts/evaluate.py runs lint, import, unit, snapshot and render gates
A PreToolUse hook blocks writes to the paths listed in harness.json
AGENTS.md is under ~100 lines and points at docs/ for depth

features.title: chat_ui: ChatWindow, ChatBubble, ChatInput, TypingIndicator
acceptance: Messages stack, align by sender, and scroll clear of the composer
Composer types character by character and can be cleared
Structural tests plus a chat_window snapshot baseline

features.title: tokens: TokenChip, TokenStrip, simple_tokenize, fake_token_id
acceptance: Leading spaces are visible and kept with the following token
Long words split into subword pieces
Token ids are deterministic across processes and machines
Structural tests plus a token_strip snapshot baseline

features.title: vectors: VectorColumn, EmbeddingGrid, VectorArrow, SemanticSpace
acceptance: Long vectors elide rather than drawing every row
Grid values map to a themed colour ramp
stable_vector is deterministic for a given string
Structural tests plus vector_column and embedding_grid baselines

features.title: network: DeviceNode, ServerRack, Link, Packet, PacketStream, RequestPath
acceptance: RequestPath lays out client, hop and server left to right
Packets animate along a link in both directions
Structural tests plus request_path and server_rack baselines

features.title: probability: ProbabilityBar, ProbabilityChart, softmax
acceptance: softmax normalises and responds correctly to temperature
Charts sort descending, support top_k, and can select one bar
Structural tests plus a probability_chart baseline

ProbabilityBar takes a value_format so a quota or utilisation meter is a keyword argument, not a second class; the default is byte-identical to the f-string it replaced and all 20 pre-existing baselines still pass untouched

features.title: transformer: LayerBlock, TransformerStack, AttentionLines, AttentionMatrix, ResidualStream
acceptance: Stacks elide the middle while reporting true depth
Attention line weight and opacity encode the weight
Attention matrices are causally masked and row-normalised
Structural tests plus transformer_stack and attention_matrix baselines

features.title: factory + camera: the continuous-shot vocabulary
acceptance: Station fits oversized content into its bay and never scales it up
Station marquees are clamped to the bay width and sit below the bay, so neighbours cannot collide
PipelineBox encloses its contents with enough pad to keep its title out of a tight shot
Conveyor exposes one path a payload can traverse across corners in a single animation
camera.focus and camera.frame_all return built animations so moves can run with the action
frame_all fits both axes, not just width
Structural tests plus station, station_marquee, pipeline_box and conveyor baselines

features.title: chat_ui.StreamingBubble: text that arrives a word at a time
acceptance: Laid out at final size up front so it never reflows mid-stream
All words on a shared baseline, with descenders still dipping below it
reveal() is clamped and monotonic in practice
Width never exceeds max_width
Structural tests plus a streaming_bubble baseline

features.title: motion.py: the motion language (easing curves + durations)
acceptance: Curves are real cubic-Beziers matching the published Material values, not approximations
Every curve starts at 0, ends at 1, is monotonic, and stays in range
Semantic aliases (ENTER/EXIT/MOVE/SNAP/FEATURE) so call sites say why, not which
Durations scale sub-linearly with distance and are clamped at both ends
Exits are shorter than entrances
Staggered group entrance helper with a non-zero lag ratio

features.title: effects.py: glow, comet trails, anticipation pulse
acceptance: glow() layers widen outward while fading, and never mutate their source
Glowing starts dark, toggles, and renders its halo behind the core
comet() follows a travelling mobject for follow-through
Structural tests plus a glow snapshot baseline

features.title: glyph.py + vendored icon set: Glyph and IconTile
acceptance: Icons are vendored (ISC-licensed Lucide), so renders are reproducible offline
Icons render stroked, not filled
Lucide's zero-length indicator dots are restored rather than silently dropped
A missing icon name raises an error that lists the alternatives
Station accepts an icon and still lays content out below the full header
Structural tests plus glyph_row, icon_tile and station_with_icon baselines

features.title: checks.py: CheckRow and CheckList
acceptance: A row reserves three columns - marker, label, right-aligned detail - so a list of names of different lengths shares all three edges
The tick is stroke-only and is hidden and shown on stroke opacity; a blanket set_opacity would draw it as two filled slivers
mark_pass/mark_fail/reset change colour and opacity only, never the submobject list, so row.animate.mark_pass() interpolates
mark_fail draws a cross, not a red tick
Type goes through lib/typography.py with an explicit frame_width; no raw font_size, no hex strings
Structural tests plus an approved check_list snapshot baseline

features.title: stacked.py: SegmentedBar
acceptance: Drawn segment widths sum to the bar length; a segment's drawn fraction is floored at min_segment so a 0.18% slice is still visible
fractions reports the UNCLAMPED truth and the legend prints the real value - legibility changes the drawing, never the data
Legend rows are built against a fixed origin, so swatches, names and values each share one edge
A legend is ONE type size: when the table is too narrow, the name and value columns are scaled by the SAME factor, never the names alone
legend_side='below' puts the table under the bar at the bar's own width, for a bay with room for the numbers but not the words
strict_legend refuses a legend that would be typed below typography.MIN_READABLE, naming both ways out
Inline labels are omitted below INLINE_MIN_FRACTION rather than squeezed into a smear
set_shown and emphasise change opacity only, so a bar can be grown and highlighted under .animate
Structural tests plus approved segmented_bar_legend, segmented_bar_legend_below and segmented_bar_inline snapshot baselines

features.title: factory-video skill: the house format, written down
acceptance: Covers the set/choreography split, motion language, icon and glow vocabulary, camera rules
Carries the framing rules that no test can check, with the reasons
Reference file records the motion standards' sources and Manim's real limits
AGENTS.md points at it rather than duplicating it

features.title: typography.py: type sized as a share of frame height
acceptance: A role occupies the same share of the frame at any camera width
Point size derives from the shot the text is read in, never hardcoded
Cap-height calibration is pinned by a test, so a Manim upgrade cannot silently rescale the catalogue
Every role clears the readability floor; audit() reports labels that do not
Station, PipelineBox and the video's labels all go through it

features.title: routing.py: orthogonal rails, path joining, clearance assertions
acceptance: join() builds a travel path out of the drawn rails, so path and diagram cannot disagree
path_clears/assert_path_clears catch a path crossing a box
chord_violations catches a fast corner the trail cuts but the path misses
elbow() keeps rails orthogonal
The video's set calls validate() at construction, so regressions fail the render gate

features.title: Motion blur disabled by default on every profile
acceptance: No profile applies frame blending unless explicitly switched on
The reason is recorded where the setting lives, not only in a commit message
--no-blur still works for a profile that opts in

features.title: Protected-path hook: narrow the Bash matcher to actual writes
features.blocked_on: human — the hook protects itself, so an agent cannot fix it
acceptance: A Bash command that merely mentions a protected path (e.g. running the Evaluator with 2>&1, or a heredoc documenting it) is allowed
A redirect whose target is a protected path is still blocked
rm/mv/cp/truncate/sed -i naming a protected path is still blocked
A test payload for each of the four cases above is recorded in the progress log

features.title: CI: run the Evaluator from the base branch on every pull request
acceptance: A workflow installs system deps, runs init.sh and runs scripts/evaluate.py
The workflow file is owned by CODEOWNERS, not editable by an agent session
A failing gate blocks the merge
